title: The Deadline
description: Finals are in two weeks. You haven't studied. Your parents expect perfect grades. The anxiety is becoming physical—you can't sleep, can't focus.

choices.label: Pull an all-nighter, study until you pass out

outcomes.narration: Coffee and determination see you through. You write the exam on fumes. The grade is decent but you spend the next week sick.

choices.label: Use a cheatsheet you found online

outcomes.narration: Your heart pounds as you slip the paper out. You get caught. The principal calls your parents. The shame is worse than any grade.

choices.label: Accept you can't win them all, study what you can

outcomes.narration: You do your best with what time you have. The grades aren't perfect, but you sleep at night. Your parents are disappointed but you know you tried.
